# Luis Howin Maina

> Designer, researcher and builder in Nairobi, Kenya. Takes interfaces, hardware and systems apart to see how they work — then builds them slightly differently.

## About

Luis Howin Maina is a Nairobi-based designer, researcher and builder, and the founder of Beben Design. His work spans UX research, mobile UI, HMI design for hardware products, brand systems, prototyping and front-end development. He builds with AI as a bench partner: taste and decisions stay human, execution gets delegated.

This site is a personal laboratory rather than a conventional portfolio: selected work with documented process, live experiments (some unfinished on purpose), and short field notes written while building.

## Location

Nairobi, Kenya (01°17′S 036°49′E, UTC+3)

## Capabilities

- UX Research: user interviews, usability testing, behavioral analysis
- UI Design: web and mobile (iOS & Android) interfaces
- HMI Design: physical-digital interfaces for hardware products
- Brand: identity systems, print and packaging
- Prototyping: interactive prototypes for validation before code
- Front-End Development: HTML, CSS, JavaScript — this site has no framework and no build step

## Selected Work

- **Moto Digital Dash** (`/moto_digital_dash.html`): glanceable, safety-critical motorcycle dashboard UI for a 4-inch circular OLED on ESP32. Sunlight, vibration, gloves, rain.
- **Trek Watch 91** (`/tw91.html`): text-first wearable interface — crown + two buttons, nine actions, no touch. Hardware prototype exists; browser demo at `/watchdemo.html`.
- **Sprite**: conversational AI site guide living on beben.design.
- **Branding & Print** (`/portfolio.html`): seven identities across logo, packaging, print and web.
- **Beben Design**: studio founded and run by Luis in Nairobi.

## Experiments

- TRWATCH emulator: 128x64 blue-OLED watch face running in the browser
- Figma-to-static pipeline: Node scripts that rebuild a design deck from a Figma frame
- Local AI workflows, habit tracking, an OS concept — statuses recorded honestly (ongoing / paused / shelved)
